name: [NEW!] Vampire Fighters
desc:
🦇 New Code at 20,000 Likes 🦇
💰Join our social server for in-game bonuses!
🧛 Drink blood to confirm your kills!

Welcome to Vampire Fighters, a melee - vampire fighting game where you fight as a vampire!

☀️ Hide from the sunlight during combat.
🦇 Turn into a vampire bat, and fly around the map!
⚔️ Join in combat with other vampires!


Level up through the ranks to become the best Vampire on Roblox!

Controls
CTRL- Shiftlock | SHIFT- Sprint
C- Crouch | C+Shift - Slide
F- Block
Q- Kick
Z- Emote
R-Reload ammo

🦇Bat Mode🦇
Space- Fly Up
T - Exit/Enter Bat Mode

Use settings to set your own keybinds.
